import redis
s=redis.Redis(host='127.0.0.1', port=6379)
t=redis.Redis(host='127.0.0.1', port=6380)
count=0
for db in range(16):
    s.execute_command('SELECT',db); t.execute_command('SELECT',db)
    sk=set(s.scan_iter()); tk=set(t.scan_iter())
    assert sk==tk, f'db{db} missing={sk-tk} extra={tk-sk}'
    for k in sk:
        a=s.type(k); b=t.type(k)
        assert a==b,(db,k,a,b)
        ea=s.pexpiretime(k); eb=t.pexpiretime(k)
        assert abs(ea-eb)<=100,(db,k,ea,eb)
        if a==b'string': va,vb=s.get(k),t.get(k)
        elif a==b'hash': va,vb=s.hgetall(k),t.hgetall(k)
        elif a==b'list': va,vb=s.lrange(k,0,-1),t.lrange(k,0,-1)
        elif a==b'set': va,vb=s.smembers(k),t.smembers(k)
        elif a==b'zset': va,vb=s.zrange(k,0,-1,withscores=True),t.zrange(k,0,-1,withscores=True)
        elif a==b'stream':
            va,vb=s.xrange(k),t.xrange(k)
            assert va==vb,(db,k,'stream entries')
            ga=s.xinfo_groups(k); gb=t.xinfo_groups(k)
            assert ga==gb,(db,k,'groups',ga,gb)
            for g in ga:
                name=g['name']
                assert s.xinfo_consumers(k,name)==t.xinfo_consumers(k,name),(db,k,'consumers',name)
                assert s.xpending_range(k,name,'-','+',100000)==t.xpending_range(k,name,'-','+',100000),(db,k,'pending',name)
            continue
        else: raise AssertionError((db,k,a))
        assert va==vb,(db,k,a)
        count+=1
    print('db', db, 'keys',len(sk),flush=True)
print('verified nonstream keys',count)
